description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising 13 slices. Each slice represents a specific data source with distinct labels, colors, and percentage values. The largest data source is NQ, accounting for approximately 31.3% of the dataset, followed by FEVER at 16.1%. SNLI and MULTINLI are the next largest contributors, with 15.4% and 11.3%, respectively. Notably, VITAMINC shows a steady decline in its contribution compared to previous years, now accounting for only 8.0% of the dataset. Additionally, SCIFACT and PUBHEALTH are among the smallest contributors, with SCIFACT slightly exceeding PUBHEALTH at 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each data source in the training set.
